sources.name: CAS Tianjin Institute of Industrial Biotechnology
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official research updates on synthetic biology, engineered microbial chassis, enzyme engineering, cell factories and biomanufacturing. Research announcements are institutional claims, not independent clinical or commercial validation.

sources.name: CAS SIAT Institute of Synthetic Biology
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official research from SIAT's Institute of Synthetic Biology, covering artificial biological components, gene circuits, synthetic genomes, engineered enzymes and cell systems. Exclude institutional meetings without a concrete technology result.

sources.name: CAS Institute of Microbiology Research
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official microbiology research with relevant work in microbial engineering, biosynthesis, engineered vaccines and therapeutic biological tools. Require a concrete biotechnology, engineering or enabling-method connection; do not treat all basic microbiology as programmable life.

sources.name: LandSpace Official News
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official Chinese commercial launch company updates on methane launch vehicles, reusable rockets, propulsion tests, launch services and satellite infrastructure. Attribute performance and commercial-readiness claims to the company.

sources.name: Galactic Energy Official News
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official Chinese commercial space company updates on Ceres and Pallas launch vehicles, rocket engines, reusable propulsion, launch operations and financing tied to its space business.

sources.name: CAS Innovation Academy for Microsatellites
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official research and mission updates on small satellites, commercial satellite constellations, satellite internet, spacecraft payloads, cargo spacecraft and satellite manufacturing. Follow only the institute's curated research-progress list; exclude awards, meetings and institutional activities without a substantive technology or operational milestone.

sources.name: CAS Institute of Metal Research
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official research developments in metals, alloys, structural and functional materials, corrosion, catalysis and material-enabled devices. Distinguish laboratory findings from demonstrated manufacturing or commercial deployment.

sources.name: CAS Ningbo Institute of Materials Technology and Engineering
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official advances in advanced polymers, composites, functional films, electronic materials, energy materials and materials-processing equipment, including pilot-scale work when explicitly documented.

sources.name: CAS Shanghai Institute of Ceramics
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official research on advanced ceramics, crystals, composites, functional and energy materials, biomaterials and related devices. Exclude conference-only notices, rankings and institutional awards without a substantive materials result.

sources.name: NeuroXess Official News
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official Chinese implantable brain-computer-interface company updates on flexible neural interfaces, neural decoding, registered clinical trials, regulatory milestones and commercialization. Preserve attribution and distinguish company-reported clinical progress from independent evidence.

sources.name: CAS Center for Excellence in Brain Science and Intelligence Technology
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official neuroscience research with relevant neural-interface, neurotechnology, brain-mapping and neural recording or modulation tools. Require a concrete enabling-technology or translational connection; not every basic neural-circuit finding is a neurotechnology advance.

sources.name: CAS SIAT Brain Cognition and Brain Diseases Institute
sources.description: [FIRST_PARTY] Official research from SIAT's brain institute, including neural-interface platforms, optical neural manipulation, computational neuroethology, neural recording and brain-analysis tools. Exclude basic disease-mechanism findings without a material technology or translational advance.
